meta.title: Laravel & React Web Development Roadmap
meta.pace: 2-3 hours per day, 6 days per week
meta.how_to_use: Do not passively watch videos. Every phase: build something small, commit it to GitHub, and use an AI coding assistant alongside you from week 1.

phases.title: PHP & Laravel Fundamentals
phases.notes: Routing, controllers, Blade templating, artisan CLI, the MVC request lifecycle.

phases.title: Eloquent ORM & Database
phases.notes: Migrations, model relationships, the query builder, seeders and factories.

phases.title: Auth, Validation & Testing
phases.notes: Laravel Breeze/Fortify authentication, form request validation, Pest/PHPUnit feature tests.

phases.title: Building APIs
phases.notes: REST resource controllers, API resources/transformers, token auth with Sanctum.

phases.title: React Fundamentals
phases.notes: Components, JSX, hooks, local state, and data fetching.

phases.title: Laravel + React Integration
phases.notes: Wiring a React frontend to a Laravel backend with Inertia.js and the Vite asset pipeline.

phases.title: Advanced Patterns & State Management
phases.notes: Queues and events on the backend, client state management and service-layer patterns.

phases.title: Deployment & Capstone Project
phases.notes: CI/CD, deploying a Laravel + React app, and building a full capstone project end to end.
